notes: ACCESS: tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl with browser UA) for robots.txt, sitemap.xml, homepage HTML, and all candidate collection pages - no block encountered, so no escalation to Playwright/Chrome was needed. robots.txt has no Claude/AI-agent specific disallow and no blanket Disallow:/ for User-agent:*; /collections/ pages are allowed. TREE: union of (1) full mega-menu (Outdoor/Living/Dining/Bedroom/Office/Lighting/Decor tier-1s, all tier-2/tier-3 links parsed from header__main-nav-mega-menu markup) and (2) sitemap_collections_1.xml (~370 /collections/ URLs, mostly marketing tag pages such as color/sale/named-furniture-collection pages e.g. hoard-collection, blu-dot-percale-bedding-collection, kvadrat-textiles/sunbrella-fabrics/swatches fabric-swatch pages - none of these are linked from the mega-menu so per rule 27/§27(textile)/§35(storage) they were treated as non-nav Collection pages and excluded). Sale/Discover tier-1 sections and all 'View All' tier-3 links were excluded per rule. QTY: each recorded node's own collection page was fetched and h1 + 'Showing 1 to N of N items' text (site's own exact count) used as evidence; h1 confirmed to match the requested slug on every row (all matched). EXCLUDED and why: Credenzas + Cabinets (/collections/credenzas-cabinets, Dining > Storage + Organization) - h1/title confirm actual products are Sideboards/Buffet Cabinets, which storage.md Sec21 lists explicitly under 'Potential Furniture', so treated as Furniture not Storage. Office Bookcases + Shelving (/collections/office-bookcases-shelving) - primary product type is bookcases (Furniture per storage.md Sec18/21), leaf name has no explicit 'storage' qualifier, excluded. All Tables+Storage/Storage(Bedroom T2)/Storage+Organization(Office/Dining T2) children that are furniture case-goods (Dressers, Nightstands+Side Tables, Storage Beds, Bar Carts, Coffee/Side/Console Tables, Media Consoles) excluded as Furniture, not Storage, per storage.md furniture boundary rules. Fabric swatch/sample pages (rug-samples, swatches, sunbrella-fabrics, kvadrat-textiles) excluded - not in nav, and swatches are furniture-customization inputs rather than standalone home-textile products. Named bedding-line collections (blu-dot-percale-bedding-collection, blu-dot-stone-washed-linen-bedding-collection) excluded as non-nav marketing Collection pages (textile.md Sec15/27) - their products are a subset already reachable via the nav 'Bedding' node. Office Storage + Cabinets and Coat Racks + Hooks and Wall Shelving (Living>Entryway /collections/shelving) included at reduced confidence (see confidence field) because they sit on the storage.md Sec18/21 shelving/cabinet ambiguity boundary but each carries explicit 'Storage' wording in its own page title/H1 or site copy. No duplicate URLs recorded even though several leaf nodes (Bedding, Pillows + Throws, Outdoor Pillows, Rugs, Coat Racks + Hooks, Storage Baskets) are cross-linked from multiple tier-1 sections (Living/Dining/Bedroom/Outdoor/Decor) - each recorded once per rule 30(textile)/38(storage). No further sub-navigation exists on any recorded collection page (only facet filters), so no grouping rows were required - all rows are flat leaves.
